title: Video Shows Grocery Store Manager Saving Toddler From Oncoming Traffic
summary_full: Luis Cruz dashed into a busy street in Puebla, Mexico, to pull a girl out of the path of an approaching S.U.V. Footage of the rescue has made him a local sensation.
